ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels accounting for approximately 90-95% of the visible fluke surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to discrete point-source anomalies and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous dark field. High-contrast white circular spots (2-8 pixels in diameter) are distributed across both lobes. A concentration of high-intensity, mottled texture is visible on the far lateral tips, particularly the right-most extremity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 10% of total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire boundary; amplitude of peaks varies between 3 and 12 pixels relative to the local edge baseline, creating a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave curve from the lateral tips toward the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular clusters (white on black) distributed throughout; higher density of these clusters on the distal third of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel, horizontal high-intensity linear marks located on the lower quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent horizontal rake marks (linear scars) on the lower left lobe and extensive circular pitting consistent with barnacle attachment/detachment scars across the entire ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy mineral or biological encrustation visible as high-intensity, irregular 3D clusters along the leading edge of the lateral tips.
